connector.name: LLM Pulse
connector.registryDescription: AI visibility analytics for brand mentions, citations, sentiment, and GEO reports
connector.summary: Hosted at api.llmpulse.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the llm-pulse account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from an LLM Pulse API key. API keys are available on Scale plans and above.
